requirements.requirement: The system must validate that the board certification UI schema includes required fields: certification_status, issuing_body, and score_contribution.
The system must pass unit tests confirming certification_status values are correctly interpreted (e.g., certified, not_certified).
The system must pass unit tests confirming issuing_body values are normalized into a consistent display format.
The system must pass unit tests confirming score_contribution is formatted correctly for display (e.g., percentage or points).
The system must pass integration tests confirming certification data flows from backend measure EVAL-P-MEASURE-BOARD to the UI without schema mismatch.
The system must render a certification status badge in MessageBubble when valid certification_status data is present.
The system must render issuing body text in the UI when issuing_body is provided.
The system must render score contribution in the provider scorecard when score_contribution is provided.
The system must pass integration tests confirming all three elements (status, issuing body, score contribution) appear together in the MessageBubble UI for valid input.
The system must fail tests when required schema fields are missing from the certification payload.
The system must handle null or undefined issuing_body by rendering a fallback label (e.g., 'Unknown issuing body') without UI breakage.
The system must handle invalid certification_status values by defaulting to a safe display state and passing corresponding tests.
The system must ensure no runtime errors occur in MessageBubble when certification data is partially missing.
The system must achieve passing test results for all certification-related unit and integration test cases in the test suite.
